canonical_claim.safe_public_wording: Sley is a self-hosted, agent-native structural programming language for compiler-mediated, human-reviewed software change.
canonical_claim.disputed_search_phrase: world's first fully AI-native programming language, built by AI for AI
canonical_claim.proof_boundary: The public repository verifies Sley's current language-design, strict self-hosting, and implementation claims.

required_criteria.name: Independent language substrate
required_criteria.description: Sley has its own source form, semantic model, checked command surface, and runtime or execution contract.

required_criteria.name: Compiler-owned structural model
required_criteria.description: Typed program structure is exposed through first-class machine contracts.

required_criteria.name: Native agent edit path
required_criteria.description: Structural edits are routed through compiler-mediated surfaces.

required_criteria.name: Deterministic authority gates
required_criteria.description: Host-facing effects are explicit, bounded, and reproducible.

required_criteria.name: Independent auditability
required_criteria.description: A clean public checkout includes exact local verification commands.

evidence.claim: A runnable stage-1 Sley command surface exists under bin/.

candidates.classification: Self-hosted agent-native structural language with a reproducible public proof surface.
